item.description: Larrakia custodians have appealed to the federal government to remediate heavy fuels and PFAS chemicals from a former Navy fuel storage base in Darwin before the land is returned to them.

item.description: A magistrate has scolded the lawyer representing the man charged with the murder of Toowoomba woman Jana Armstrong "this is not my first rodeo" after he tried to separate an unrelated assault charge from the case.

item.title: ABC News: David Jones suppliers say store closures could be good news
item.description: Some suppliers think a streamlined David Jones could be good news for their sales if it encourages more shoppers into fewer, higher-performing stores.

item.description: Parramatta decides not to extend Josh Addo-Carr's contract beyond next season, leaving him free to join a new team immediately if he chooses to do so.

item.description: Scott Gladman's mission to swim roughly 16 kilometres a day for more than three months came after two mates were diagnosed with MND and Parkinson's, respectively.

item.description: After a week of conversation about ball tampering from the 2018 tour of South Africa, Australia Test captain Pat Cummins is set to respond publicly.

item.description: WA Premier Roger Cook reminds MPs of their responsibilities after a group of Labor members tried to shield their colleague Jags Krishnan from media questioning as he entered parliament yesterday.
